snippet.title: Grounded 2 - Beat the Heat Update Trailer
snippet.description:
It’s time to turn up the heat in Grounded 2! Take on King Dozer, a massive horned lizard boss that brings a dangerous new threat to the park. (Trust us, it's going to be HARD.)

Discover Buggy Progression to evolve your favorite buggies, explore the mysterious Sinkhole Anthill, and survive against modified O.R.C. creatures. Spring has sprung in Brookhollow Park, with new combat updates and deeper survival systems to uncover.

The Beat the Heat Update is now live in Game Preview on Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, and Xbox Cloud, and in Early Access on Steam. Play it today with Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass. 
___
